'''Motoko Kumai''' (Japanese: '''まいもとこ''' ''Kumai Motoko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Kumai was born on September 8, 1970 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She has frequently voiced characters in various episodes since {{aniseries|OS}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Kumai is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}. From December 21, 2006, to October 2007, Motoko took a sabbatical after coming down with an illness that required medical treatment.
